snippet.title: He-Man & The Masters Of The Universe: Dragon Pearl Of Destruction – Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Defend Eternia and experience 13 action-packed stages in He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction. Play as He-Man, She-Ra, Man-At-Arms, and Teela, and take on Skeletor's evil forces! Team up with a friend for local co-op action to double the fun!

The game will be available on Nintendo Switch on February 4th, 2027!

Wishlist now!: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749580/HeMan_and_the_Masters_of_the_Universe_Dragon_Pearl_of_Destruction/
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10020938
https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9mww1bpdkkgx
https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/he-man-and-the-masters-of-the-universe-dragon-pearl-of-destruction-switch/

The physical version is available for pre-order over on the Clear River Games shop for Europe:
https://shop.clearrivergames.com/collections/he-man-and-the-masters-of-the-universe%E2%84%A2-dragon-pearl-of-destruction

Also available on the Limited Run Games store for North America: 
https://limitedrungames.com/collections/he-man-and-the-masters-of-the-universe-dragon-pearl-of-destruction
